title: Single-cell and Spatial omics analysis pipeline
text: scop R package comprehensive single-cell spatial omics analysis, providing modular workflows analyzing, integrating, visualizing, interactively exploring single-cell spatial omics data. Documentation: https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/ Function reference examples: https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/ Changelog: https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/news/index.html Integrated quality control methods single-cell RNA-seq single-cell ATAC-seq, including cell cycle analysis: Seurat gene-set scoring, scran::cyclone, tricycle discrete continuous cell cycle state estimation, doublet detection methods (scDblFinder, scds, Scrublet, DoubletDetection) ambient RNA decontamination via decontX. Pipelines embedded multiple methods normalization, highly variable feature selection, feature reduction (PCA, ICA, NMF, MDS, GLMPCA, UMAP, TriMap, LargeVis, PaCMAP, PHATE, DM, FR), cell population identification, including optional scran-based deconvolution normalization HVF modeling. Pipelines embedded multiple integration methods scRNA-seq data, including Uncorrected, Seurat CCA/RPCA workflows, scVI, MNN, fastMNN, Harmony, Scanorama, BBKNN, CSS, Coralysis, LIGER, Conos, ComBat. Pipelines embedded RNA + ATAC multimodal integration methods, including Seurat v5 integration, WNN-based integration, GLUE, MultiMAP, cross-modality co-embedding workflows. Multiple methods automatic annotation single-cell data (CellTypist, SciBet, SingleR, Scmap, KNNPredict), significance-based hierarchical clustering CHOIR, methods projection single-cell datasets (CSSMap, PCAMap, SeuratMap, SymphonyMap). Bulk transcriptomics cellular composition workflows, including differential expression via DESeq2, edgeR, limma-voom, dream, deconvolution via MuSiC, BisqueRNA, BayesPrism, Cell2location, cell-type-specific differential expression via TOAST, composition analysis Milo, propeller, scCODA, permutation-based tests, scProportionTest. Differential expression perturbation analysis: identification differential features, expressed marker identification, rare-cell population detection RareQ, phenotype-associated cell selection Scissor, feature-weight phenotype scoring FWP, network comparison scTenifoldNet, -silico perturbation analysis scTenifoldKnk. Enrichment, functional scoring: -representation analysis, GSEA analysis, GSVA, AUCell, UCell, metabolic pathway activity inference via scMetabolism, metabolic flux estimation via scFEA. Transcription factor activity analysis via DoRothEA, SCENIC/SCENIC+, GRNBoost2, GENIE3, cisTarget, dynamic enrichment analysis. CNV analysis scRNA-seq copykat, infercnv, SCEVAN, fastCNV, plus tumor microenvironment scoring via ESTIMATE. Cellular potency: CytoTRACE 2 FitDevo predicting cellular differentiation potential. RNA velocity: RNA velocity, Cell2fate, PAGA, Palantir, CellRank, WOT. Trajectory inference: Slingshot, Monocle2, Monocle3, developmental direction inference VECTOR, identification dynamic features. Cell-cell communication: CellChat, spatially constrained SpatialCellChat, CellphoneDB, NicheNet, MultiNicheNet, LIANA. Cellular composition analysis: differential abundance proportion testing across conditions. Spatial analysis: modular domain (Banksy, BayesSpace, PRECAST), feature, neighborhood, integration, deconvolution (SPOTlight, SpaNorm, CARDspa), spot QC (SpotSweeper), SpatialCellChat communication workflows; native spatial networks cell-boundary visualization; lightweight bridge Giotto without wrapping full framework. High-quality data visualization methods. Fast deployment single-cell data SCExplorer, shiny app provides interactive visualization interface.

title: Single-cell and Spatial omics analysis pipeline
text: scop package developed based SCP package, following major improvements: Compatibility: full support Seurat v5. Stability: large number known issues fixed, functions passed devtools::check(). Usability: Python environment setup workflow improved, support conda-compatible managers including conda, mamba, micromamba; standardized console messages via thisutils::log_message consistent, readable function outputs. Performance: new parallel framework developed based thisutils::parallelize_fun, providing consistent experience across Linux, macOS, Windows. Functionality: analysis methods added.

title: Single-cell and Spatial omics analysis pipeline
text: analysis based subsetted version mouse pancreas data.
code: library(scop) data(pancreas_sub) print(pancreas_sub) #> An object of class Seurat  #> 47994 features across 1000 samples within 3 assays  #> Active assay: RNA (15998 features, 0 variable features) #>  1 layer present: counts #>  2 other assays present: spliced, unspliced pancreas_sub <- RunStandardWorkflow(pancreas_sub) print(pancreas_sub) #>  An object of class Seurat  #>  47994 features across 1000 samples within 3 assays  #>  Active assay: RNA (15998 features, 2000 variable features) #>   3 layers present: counts, data, scale.data #>   2 other assays present: spliced, unspliced #>   5 dimensional reductions calculated: Standardpca, StandardpcaUMAP2D, StandardpcaUMAP3D, StandardUMAP2D, StandardUMAP3D CellDimPlot(   pancreas_sub,   group.by = c("CellType", "SubCellType"),   reduction = "UMAP",   xlab = "UMAP_1",   ylab = "UMAP_2" ) CellDimPlot(   pancreas_sub,   group.by = "SubCellType",   stat.by = "Phase",   reduction = "UMAP",   theme_use = "theme_blank",   xlab = "UMAP_1",   ylab = "UMAP_2" ) FeatureDimPlot(   pancreas_sub,   features = c("Sox9", "Neurog3", "Fev", "Rbp4"),   reduction = "UMAP",   theme_use = "theme_blank",   xlab = "UMAP_1",   ylab = "UMAP_2" ) FeatureDimPlot(   pancreas_sub,   features = c("Ins1", "Gcg", "Sst", "Ghrl"),   compare_features = TRUE,   label = TRUE,   label_insitu = TRUE,   reduction = "UMAP",   theme_use = "theme_blank",   xlab = "UMAP_1",   ylab = "UMAP_2" ) ht <- GroupHeatmap(   pancreas_sub,   features = c(     "Sox9", "Anxa2", # Ductal     "Neurog3", "Hes6", # EPs     "Fev", "Neurod1", # Pre-endocrine     "Rbp4", "Pyy", # Endocrine     "Ins1", "Gcg", "Sst", "Ghrl" # Beta, Alpha, Delta, Epsilon   ),   group.by = c("CellType", "SubCellType"),   heatmap_palette = "Spectral",   cell_annotation = c("Phase", "G2M_score", "Cdh2"),   cell_annotation_palette = c("Dark2", "Chinese", "Chinese"),   show_row_names = TRUE,   nlabel = 0,   row_names_side = "left",   add_dot = TRUE,   add_reticle = TRUE,   width = 2.2,   height = 2.5 ) print(ht$plot)

code: genenames <- make.unique(   thisutils::capitalize(     rownames(panc8_sub[["RNA"]]),     force_tolower = TRUE   ) ) names(genenames) <- rownames(panc8_sub) panc8_rename <- RenameFeatures(   panc8_sub,   newnames = genenames,   assays = "RNA" ) srt_query <- RunKNNMap(   srt_query = pancreas_sub,   srt_ref = panc8_rename,   ref_umap = "HarmonyUMAP2D" ) ProjectionPlot(   srt_query = srt_query,   srt_ref = panc8_rename,   query_group = "SubCellType",   ref_group = "celltype",   ref_param = list(     xlab = "UMAP_1",     ylab = "UMAP_2"   ) )

"gene" —  pathway-related ligand/receptor gene expression panel. "ranknet" — pathway ranking comparison plot. "scatter" — outgoing vs. incoming signaling strength scatter. NULL uses default assay. do_normalization Whether data normalization performed. normalization_method normalization method used. Possible values "LogNormalize", "SCT", "TFIDF", "scran". do_HVF_finding, HVF_method, nHVF, HVF Highly variable features. HVF_method "vst", "mvp", "disp", "scran". HVF_min_intersection feature needs present batches minimum number times order considered highly variable. do_scaling Force scaling via ScaleData. vars_to_regress vector variable names include additional regression variables. regression_model "linear", "poisson", "negativebinomial". scale_within_batch Scale within batch. used "Uncorrected", "Seurat", "MNN", "Harmony", "BBKNN", "CSS", "ComBat". linear_reduction, linear_reduction_dims, linear_reduction_dims_use, linear_reduction_params, force_linear_reduction Linear reduction ("pca", "svd", "ica", "nmf", "mds", "glmpca"). linear_reduction_dims_use = NULL uses estimated dimensions, else first 50. nonlinear_reduction, nonlinear_reduction_dims, nonlinear_reduction_params, force_nonlinear_reduction Nonlinear reduction ("umap", "umap-naive", "tsne", "dm", "phate", "pacmap", "trimap", "largevis", "fr"). neighbor_metric, neighbor_k Neighbor graph ("euclidean", "cosine", "manhattan", "hamming"). cluster_algorithm, cluster_resolution Clustering ("louvain", "slm", "leiden"). Larger cluster_resolution yields fewer clusters. gene_activity_assay Name gene activity assay used provide shared feature space RNA-ATAC integration. MultiMAP_params list parameters passed `MultiMAP::Integration`. following keys managed internally supplied: `"adatas"`, `"use_reps"`, `"embedding"`, `"seed"`. verbose Whether print message. title: Plot Palantir trajectories — PalantirTrajectoryPlot
text: srt Seurat object. reduction Reduction plot. NULL uses DefaultReduction. dims Length-2 vector dimensions plot. cells Cell names include. pseudotime_key Name metadata column containing Palantir pseudotime. branch_cols Metadata columns containing Palantir branch probabilities. NULL, columns ending "_diff_potential" used, excluding pseudotime_key diff_potential_key. diff_potential_key Name Palantir entropy/differentiation potential column exclude branch auto-detection. pseudotime_interval Numeric vector length 2 specifying pseudotime range plot. branch_min_prob Minimum branch probability used select cells branch trajectory. n_bins Number pseudotime bins used summarize trajectory. min_cells_per_bin Minimum number cells required bin. smooth Whether smooth trajectory stats::loess. trajectory_method Method used fit trajectory coordinates along pseudotime. "loess" uses fully R-native smoother Palantir-style pseudotime grid; "bin" uses binned median coordinates. smoothness Smoothing multiplier R-native loess span. Higher values yield smoother curves. span Base span used loess smoothing. n_path_points Number pseudotime points used draw smoothed trajectory. cell_color Cell coloring mode. Use "pseudotime" Palantir pseudotime, "branch_selection" branch highest probability, "none" hide cell coloring, metadata column. pt.size Point size cells. pt.alpha Point alpha cells. palette, palcolor Palette name (thisplot::show_palettes) custom colors. trajectory_palette Color palette trajectories. trajectory_palcolor Custom colors trajectories. trajectory_linewidth Line width trajectories. trajectory_bg Color trajectory background stroke. trajectory_bg_stroke Width added trajectory background stroke. trajectory_arrow Arrow used trajectories. See grid::arrow. aspect.ratio Panel aspect ratio. title, subtitle, xlab, ylab Plot labels. legend.position Legend placement ("none", "left", "right", "bottom", "top"), direction, title. legend.title = NULL uses group name. legend.direction Legend direction: "horizontal" "vertical". theme_use, theme_args Theme name function, plus extra theme arguments. return_layer Logical. TRUE, returns ggplot2 layers instead complete plot. seed Random seed. verbose Whether print messages.

title: Prepare the python environment — PrepareEnv
text: envname Conda-compatible Python environment. NULL, environment name set "scop_env". conda path command name conda-compatible executable (conda, mamba, micromamba). Use "auto" allow automatically finding appropriate environment manager. "micromamba" requested micromamba available PATH, package-managed micromamba downloaded automatically. miniconda_repo Repository URL miniconda. Default https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda. version Python version. Default "3.10-1" macOS Unix "3.11-1" Windows. Existing compatible environments reused; trajectory package pins selected actual Python 3.10/3.11/3.12 profile. force Whether force recreation environment. TRUE, existing environment removed recreated. modules Optional Python dependency modules install addition default scientific stack. NULL omitted PrepareEnv(), default environment installed. default excludes "cell2location", "cell2fate", "commot", "sccoda", "scomm" workflows use long-running incompatible dependency stacks. Cell2fate COMMOT prepared standalone "cell2fate_env" "commot_env" environments Python 3.9. "scenic" also excluded default environment prepared "scenic_env" default SCENIC requires older Python/numpy stack. "scmalignantfinder" prepared standalone "scmalignantfinder_env" upstream package pins older scanpy/anndata stack. Windows, default also excludes "scvi", "glue", "multimap" upstream stacks reliable requested explicitly method-specific workflows. pip_options Additional command line arguments passed uv/pip installing pip packages. components Components prepare. Supported values "python", "r", ""; "" expands Python R. default, "python", preserves existing Python-behavior. R component collects packages declared check_r() checks/installs , including optional workflow dependencies listed DESCRIPTION. CHOIR R-, PrepareEnv(modules = "choir") prepares pinned optional R backend without creating Python environment. cores Number workers R-package installation. Use NULL (default) let pak select worker count automatically. verbose Whether print message. Default TRUE. ... Additional arguments passed package installation functions.

title: Proportion Test Plot — ProportionTestPlot
text: Generate differential-abundance plots based results RunProportionTest. Supports legacy storage method-layer storage multi-method proportion-test workflow.

title: Proportion Test Plot — ProportionTestPlot
text: srt Seurat object containing proportion-test results. comparison comparison plot. NULL, plots comparisons. proportion_method Optional method select srt@tools[['ProportionTest']][['methods']]. NULL, uses active/recent method. result_level Result level draw. Currently "group" used. plot_type Plot type. One "effect" "umap". umap_mode UMAP projection mode plot_type = "umap". "discrete" maps cells DA direction categories; "continuous" maps cells group-level obs_log2FD. reduction Reduction name used UMAP projection. projection_args Additional arguments passed CellDimPlot (umap_mode = "discrete") FeatureDimPlot (umap_mode = "continuous"). FDR_threshold FDR value cutoff significance. log2FD_threshold Absolute value log2FD cutoff significance. order_by Method order clusters. Options: "name" (alphabetical), "value" (log2FD value). palette Color palette name continuous effect coloring. palcolor Custom colors palette. group_palette Palette cluster/group coloring. group_palcolor Custom colors group_palette. pt.size size points. pt.alpha Point transparency. cols.sig Color significant/credible points intervals. cols.ns Color non-significant points intervals. cols.increase Default color increased DA groups. cols.decrease Default color decreased DA groups. effect_color_mode Coloring mode plot_type = "effect". Use "directional" (default) increased/decreased/NS colors, "classic" legacy significant/non-significant coloring. nlabel Number labels added label = TRUE features_label = NULL. features_label Character vector specifying points label. label Whether add labels. label.fg Label foreground color. label.bg Label background color. label.bg.r Label background radius. label.size Label text size. aspect.ratio Aspect ratio panel. xlab X-axis label. plot_type = "umap", forwarded projection plot set. ylab Y-axis label. plot_type = "umap", forwarded projection plot set. theme_use, theme_args Theme name function, plus extra theme arguments. legend.position position legends, one "none", "left", "right", "bottom", "top". legend.direction Legend direction: "horizontal" "vertical". legend.title Title legend. combine, nrow, ncol, byrow Combine plots patchwork. combine = FALSE returns list ggplots. seed Random seed. verbose Whether print messages.

title: Single-cell reference mapping with CSS method — RunCSSMap
text: srt_query object class Seurat annotated cell types. srt_ref Seurat object count matrix representing reference object. provided, similarities calculated cells query reference objects. provided, similarities calculated within query object. query_assay assay use query object. provided, default assay query object used. ref_assay assay use reference object. provided, default assay reference object used. ref_css CSS reduction reference object use calculating distance metric. ref_umap Name UMAP reduction reference object. provided, first UMAP reduction found reference object used. ref_group grouping variable reference object. variable used group cells heatmap columns. provided, cells treated one group. projection_method Projection method use. Options "model" "knn". "model" selected, function try use pre-trained UMAP model reference object projection. "knn" selected, function directly find nearest neighbors using distance metric. nn_method Nearest neighbor search method use. Options "raw", "annoy", "rann". "raw" selected, function use brute-force method find nearest neighbors. "annoy" selected, function use Annoy library approximate nearest neighbor search. "rann" selected, function use RANN library approximate nearest neighbor search. provided, function choose search method based size query reference datasets. finite dense inputs using cosine Euclidean distance, raw path uses bounded-memory compiled top-k kernel unless full distance matrix requested. metrics sparse inputs retain existing proxyC path. k number nearest neighbors find cell query object. distance_metric distance metric use calculating pairwise distances cells. Options include: "pearson", "spearman", "cosine", "correlation", "jaccard", "ejaccard", "dice", "edice", "hamman", "simple matching", "faith". Additional distance metrics can also used, "euclidean", "manhattan", "hamming", etc. vote_fun Function used aggregating nearest neighbors reference object. Options "mean", "median", "sum", "min", "max", "sd", "var", etc. provided, default "mean". verbose Whether print message. Default TRUE.

GPCCA provides coarse-grained analysis Schur decomposition. use_connectivity_kernel Whether combine main kernel ConnectivityKernel. velocity_weight Weight VelocityKernel combining ConnectivityKernel. connectivity_weight Weight ConnectivityKernel combining VelocityKernel. title: Run CytoTRACE 2 — RunCytoTRACE
text: Predicts cellular developmental potential single-cell RNA-seq data using CytoTRACE 2 algorithm (Kang et al., 2025). default, function uses official CytoTRACE2 R package. Set backend = "cpp" use package R/C++ implementation. algorithm consists five stages: Preprocessing: Gene orthology mapping, feature selection, ranking, log2-CPM transformation. GSBN Ensemble Prediction: 19 pre-trained Gene Set Binary Network models predict continuous developmental potency score (0-1) discrete potency category. Diffusion Smoothing: Markov random-walk--restart cell-cell similarity graph smooths raw scores. Binning: Within potency category, cells ranked linearly scaled corresponding segments unit interval. Adaptive kNN Smoothing: PCA-based nearest-neighbor consensus refinement final scores.

"cpp" default uses fast native hypergeometric ORA implementation returns enrichment table without enrichResult objects. "r" uses clusterProfiler::enricher() returns enrichResult objects results. GO_simplify = TRUE currently uses R backend. cores number worker processes use parallelization. Default 1. verbose Whether print message. Additional backend-specific arguments. assay Assay used `object` Seurat object. layer Assay layer used `object` Seurat object. regulators Candidate transcription factor genes. targets Optional target genes. `NULL`, genes GRN matrix considered candidate targets. backend Runtime backend. Supports `"cpp"` `"python"`. max_edges_per_target Maximum incoming regulator edges retained per target. default `Inf` keeps positive-importance links, matching arboreto GRNBoost2 output. n_rounds Number boosting rounds GRNBoost2-like tree ensemble inference. default follows arboreto `SGBM_KWARGS`. learning_rate GRNBoost2-like tree ensemble learning rate. max_depth Maximum depth regression tree. max_features Fraction candidate regulators sampled tree split. subsample Fraction cells sampled boosting round. early_stop_window_length --bag improvement window used GRNBoost2 early stopping. exclude_self Whether native GRNBoost2-like inference excludes target gene regulator feature set. importance_norm_power Power used normalize native GRNBoost2-like edge importance total importance target. Set `0` disable normalization. correlation_fill Whether native GRNBoost2-like inference fill missing TF-target candidates expression-correlation support applying `max_edges_per_target`. boost_weight Weight native boosting score used correlation fill enabled. correlation_weight Weight correlation-fill score relative native boosting importance. covariance_weight Weight covariance score used correlation fill enabled. correlation_method Correlation method used native GRNBoost2-like candidate filling. output_file Optional path adjacency table written. work_dir Working directory used Python backends. prefix Prefix temporary Python backend files. envname Python environment used Python backends. `NULL`, `backend = "python"` uses isolated `"scenic_env"` environment. conda Conda-compatible executable used Python backends. cores Number workers used native/Python GRNBoost2. seed Random seed passed supported backends. force Whether rebuild existing `output_file`. verbose Whether print progress messages. genes_in Matrix orientation matrix inputs. `"rows"` means genes x cells; `"columns"` means cells x genes.

TERM2GENE data frame specifying gene-term mapping custom database. first column contain term IDs, second column contain gene IDs. TERM2NAME data frame specifying term-name mapping custom database. first column contain term IDs, second column contain corresponding term names. minGSSize minimum size gene set considered enrichment analysis. maxGSSize maximum size gene set considered enrichment analysis. unlimited_db Names databases size restrictions. method method use GSVA. Options "gsva", "ssgsea", "zscore", "plage". Multiple methods can supplied ; single-cell mode stored method-suffixed assays "GSVA_gsva" "GSVA_ssgsea". backend Scoring backend. NULL "auto" automatically chunks large matrices reduce peak dense intermediate memory; positive values set chunk size manually. kcdf kernel cumulative distribution function used GSVA. title: Integration workflow — RunIntegration
text: srt_merge merged `Seurat` object includes batch information. batch Batch variable name. append Append integrated results srt_merge. srt_list list Seurat objects checked preprocessed. assay Assay use. NULL uses default assay. integration_methods Method(s) run. Multiple methods require append = TRUE applied sequentially. ChromatinAssay, prefer "Uncorrected" "Harmony5". compute_lisi, lisi_label_colnames, lisi_reduction, lisi_dims, lisi_prefix, lisi_tool_name, lisi_perplexity, lisi_tol, lisi_max_iter, lisi_knn_algorithm, lisi_cores, lisi_max_dense_bytes LISI scores. lisi_label_colnames = NULL uses batch single metadata column; lisi_reduction = NULL uses DefaultReduction(). compute_metrics, metrics_batch_col, metrics_celltype_col, metrics_reduction, metrics_cluster_col, metrics_tool_name, metrics_k_graph Integration summary metrics selected reduction. do_normalization Whether data normalization performed. normalization_method normalization method used. Possible values "LogNormalize", "SCT", "TFIDF", "scran". do_HVF_finding, HVF_method, nHVF, HVF Highly variable features. HVF_method "vst", "mvp", "disp", "scran". HVF_source source highly variable features. Possible values "global" "separate". HVF_min_intersection feature needs present batches minimum number times order considered highly variable. do_scaling Force scaling via ScaleData. vars_to_regress vector variable names include additional regression variables. regression_model "linear", "poisson", "negativebinomial". scale_within_batch Scale within batch. used "Uncorrected", "Seurat", "MNN", "Harmony", "BBKNN", "CSS", "ComBat". linear_reduction, linear_reduction_dims, linear_reduction_dims_use, linear_reduction_params, force_linear_reduction Linear reduction ("pca", "svd", "ica", "nmf", "mds", "glmpca"). linear_reduction_dims_use = NULL uses estimated dimensions, else first 50. nonlinear_reduction, nonlinear_reduction_dims, nonlinear_reduction_params, force_nonlinear_reduction Nonlinear reduction ("umap", "umap-naive", "tsne", "dm", "phate", "pacmap", "trimap", "largevis", "fr"). neighbor_metric, neighbor_k Neighbor graph ("euclidean", "cosine", "manhattan", "hamming"). cluster_algorithm, cluster_resolution Clustering ("louvain", "slm", "leiden"). Larger cluster_resolution yields fewer clusters. seed Random seed. verbose Whether print message. Default TRUE. integration_method Deprecated alias integration_methods. ... Passed integration method functions.

title: Benchmark single-cell integration methods — RunIntegrationBenchmark
text: Run one RunIntegration() methods input, score latent embedding scIB-style batch-correction bio-conservation metrics (scaled iLISI/cLISI, ASW, graph connectivity, ARI/NMI), store tables srt@tools$IntegrationBenchmark. object returned later plotting can reuse embeddings per-cell LISI scores.

title: Benchmark single-cell integration methods — RunIntegrationBenchmark
code: RunIntegrationBenchmark(   srt,   batch,   celltype = NULL,   methods = c("Uncorrected", "Harmony"),   linear_reduction = "pca",   nHVF = 2000,   linear_reduction_dims = 50,   linear_reduction_dims_use = NULL,   nonlinear_reduction = "umap",   perplexity = 30,   k_graph = 15,   bio_weight = 0.6,   batch_weight = 0.4,   skip_failed = TRUE,   tool_name = "IntegrationBenchmark",   verbose = TRUE,   ... )

title: Benchmark single-cell integration methods — RunIntegrationBenchmark
text: srt Seurat object containing batch column. batch Metadata column used technical batch. celltype Optional metadata column used biological labels. methods Integration methods passed RunIntegration(). perplexity Neighborhood size RunLISI(). k_graph Neighbor size graph connectivity. bio_weight, batch_weight Weights used overall score. Defaults follow scIB (0.6 bio conservation, 0.4 batch correction). skip_failed Whether failed method recorded skipped. tool_name Name srt@tools entry used store tables. verbose Whether print message. Default TRUE. ... message print.

title: Benchmark single-cell integration methods — RunIntegrationBenchmark
text: input Seurat object integration reductions, per-cell LISI columns, srt@tools[[tool_name]] containing summary, metrics, runs. Print tables thisplot::print_colored_table().

title: Benchmark single-cell integration methods — RunIntegrationBenchmark
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ data(panc8_sub) panc8_sub <- RunIntegrationBenchmark(   panc8_sub,   batch = "tech",   celltype = "celltype",   methods = c("Uncorrected", "Harmony"),   nHVF = 500,   linear_reduction_dims = 20,   linear_reduction_dims_use = 1:10,   perplexity = 10 ) thisplot::print_colored_table(   panc8_sub@tools$IntegrationBenchmark$summary,   by = "row",   palette = "Chinese" ) thisplot::print_colored_table(   panc8_sub@tools$IntegrationBenchmark$metrics,   by = "col",   palette = "Paired" ) IntegrationBenchmarkPlot(panc8_sub) IntegrationBenchmarkPlot(panc8_sub, plot_type = "box") } # }

what: Single-cell reference mapping with KNN method — RunKNNMap
title: Single-cell reference mapping with KNN method — RunKNNMap
text: Performs single-cell reference mapping using K-nearest neighbor (KNN) method. takes two single-cell datasets input: srt_query srt_ref. function maps cells srt_query dataset srt_ref dataset based similarity distance.

title: Single-cell reference mapping with KNN method — RunKNNMap
code: RunKNNMap(   srt_query,   srt_ref,   query_assay = NULL,   ref_assay = NULL,   ref_umap = NULL,   ref_group = NULL,   features = NULL,   nfeatures = 2000,   query_reduction = NULL,   ref_reduction = NULL,   query_dims = 1:30,   ref_dims = 1:30,   projection_method = c("model", "knn"),   nn_method = NULL,   k = 30,   distance_metric = "cosine",   vote_fun = "mean",   verbose = TRUE )

title: Single-cell reference mapping with KNN method — RunKNNMap
text: srt_query object class Seurat annotated cell types. srt_ref Seurat object count matrix representing reference object. provided, similarities calculated cells query reference objects. provided, similarities calculated within query object. query_assay assay use query object. provided, default assay query object used. ref_assay assay use reference object. provided, default assay reference object used. ref_umap Name UMAP reduction reference object. provided, first UMAP reduction found reference object used. ref_group grouping variable reference object. variable used group cells heatmap columns. provided, cells treated one group. features vector feature names include heatmap. provided, highly variable features (HVF) used. nfeatures maximum number features include heatmap. query_reduction Name dimensionality reduction query object use calculating distance metric. ref_reduction Name dimensionality reduction reference object use calculating distance metric. query_dims Dimension indices query reduction used calculating distance metric. ref_dims Dimension indices reference reduction used calculating distance metric. projection_method Projection method use. Options "model" "knn". "model" selected, function try use pre-trained UMAP model reference object projection. "knn" selected, function directly find nearest neighbors using distance metric. nn_method Nearest neighbor search method use. Options "raw", "annoy", "rann". "raw" selected, function use brute-force method find nearest neighbors. "annoy" selected, function use Annoy library approximate nearest neighbor search. "rann" selected, function use RANN library approximate nearest neighbor search. provided, function choose search method based size query reference datasets. finite dense inputs using cosine Euclidean distance, raw path uses bounded-memory compiled top-k kernel unless full distance matrix requested. metrics sparse inputs retain existing proxyC path. k number nearest neighbors find cell query object. distance_metric distance metric use calculating pairwise distances cells. Options include: "pearson", "spearman", "cosine", "correlation", "jaccard", "ejaccard", "dice", "edice", "hamman", "simple matching", "faith". Additional distance metrics can also used, "euclidean", "manhattan", "hamming", etc. vote_fun Function used aggregating nearest neighbors reference object. Options "mean", "median", "sum", "min", "max", "sd", "var", etc. provided, default "mean". verbose Whether print message. Default TRUE.

title: Single-cell reference mapping with KNN method — RunKNNMap

title: Run KNN prediction — RunKNNPredict

NULL, features query reference data used. features_type Type features used KNN prediction. Must one "", "query", "ref". nfeatures Maximum number features used KNN prediction. DEtest_param list parameters passed differential expression test function features_type set "DE". DE_threshold Threshold used filter DE features. using "roc" test, DE_threshold needs reassigned. e.g. "power > 0.5". nn_method Nearest neighbor search method use. Options "raw", "annoy", "rann". "raw" selected, function use brute-force method find nearest neighbors. "annoy" selected, function use Annoy library approximate nearest neighbor search. "rann" selected, function use RANN library approximate nearest neighbor search. provided, function choose search method based size query reference datasets. finite dense inputs using cosine Euclidean distance, raw path uses bounded-memory compiled top-k kernel unless full distance matrix requested. metrics sparse inputs retain existing proxyC path. distance_metric Distance metric used calculating similarity cells. Must one "cosine", "euclidean", "manhattan", "hamming". k number nearest neighbors considered KNN prediction. filter_lowfreq Threshold filtering low-frequency cell types predicted results. Cell types frequency lower filter_lowfreq labelled "unreliable". Default 0, means filtering performed. prefix Prefix added resulting annotations. verbose Whether print message. Default TRUE.

"python" keeps original scanpy workflow remains default. "cpp" uses package C++ implementation standard connectivity graph tree, plus approximate R igraph layout stored paga$pos. arguments stay selected backend; C++ backend never switches Python implicitly. return_seurat Whether return Seurat object instead anndata object. verbose Whether print message. title: Single-cell reference mapping with PCA method — RunPCAMap
text: srt_query object class Seurat annotated cell types. srt_ref Seurat object count matrix representing reference object. provided, similarities calculated cells query reference objects. provided, similarities calculated within query object. query_assay assay use query object. provided, default assay query object used. ref_assay assay use reference object. provided, default assay reference object used. ref_pca Name PCA reduction reference object use calculating distance metric. NULL (default), automatically detected first PCA reduction. ref_dims Dimension indices reference reduction used calculating distance metric. ref_umap Name UMAP reduction reference object. provided, first UMAP reduction found reference object used. ref_group grouping variable reference object. variable used group cells heatmap columns. provided, cells treated one group. projection_method Projection method use. Options "model" "knn". "model" selected, function try use pre-trained UMAP model reference object projection. "knn" selected, function directly find nearest neighbors using distance metric. nn_method Nearest neighbor search method use. Options "raw", "annoy", "rann". "raw" selected, function use brute-force method find nearest neighbors. "annoy" selected, function use Annoy library approximate nearest neighbor search. "rann" selected, function use RANN library approximate nearest neighbor search. provided, function choose search method based size query reference datasets. finite dense inputs using cosine Euclidean distance, raw path uses bounded-memory compiled top-k kernel unless full distance matrix requested. metrics sparse inputs retain existing proxyC path. k number nearest neighbors find cell query object. distance_metric distance metric use calculating pairwise distances cells. Options include: "pearson", "spearman", "cosine", "correlation", "jaccard", "ejaccard", "dice", "edice", "hamman", "simple matching", "faith". Additional distance metrics can also used, "euclidean", "manhattan", "hamming", etc. vote_fun Function used aggregating nearest neighbors reference object. Options "mean", "median", "sum", "min", "max", "sd", "var", etc. provided, default "mean". verbose Whether print message. Default TRUE.

"python" keeps original scVelo workflow. "cpp" uses package C++ implementation stochastic velocity embedding compatible VelocityPlot. C++ backend never switches Python implicitly. max_dense_gib Maximum estimated GiB allowed dense expression working matrices used C++ path. return_seurat Whether return Seurat object instead anndata object. verbose Whether print message. Options include: "pearson", "spearman", "cosine", "correlation", "jaccard", "ejaccard", "dice", "edice", "hamman", "simple matching", "faith". Additional distance metrics can also used, "euclidean", "manhattan", "hamming", etc. vote_fun Function used aggregating nearest neighbors reference object. title: Run official SpaTalk spatial communication analysis — RunSpaTalk
text: srt `Seurat` spatial object. group.Metadata column containing cell labels single-cell mode. mode Analysis mode. `"auto"` selects spot mode `reference` supplied single-cell mode otherwise. reference Optional single-cell `Seurat` reference spot mode. reference.group.Cell-type column `reference`. species SpaTalk species database. assay, layer Spatial assay raw-count layer. reference.assay, reference.layer Reference assay raw-count layer. image Explicit spatial image. Required multi-image objects. coord.cols Metadata coordinate columns used image present. deconvolution Spot deconvolution mode. `"NNLM"` runs SpaTalk method 1; `"RCTD"` reuses `srt@tools[[rctd.tool]]$weights` [RunRCTD()] (explicitly supplied `dec_result`); `"none"` requires named external `dec_result` matrix `...`. Imported matrices use SpaTalk method 2. rctd.tool Tool key containing stored RCTD weights `deconvolution = "RCTD"`. result.name Stored result name. store.object Whether store full upstream SpaTalk object. overwrite Whether replace existing named result. backend Backend used SCOP CCC result aggregation. verbose Whether print progress messages. ... title: Benchmark spatial domain clustering methods — RunSpatialBenchmark
text: srt spatial Seurat object. gold_standard Either one metadata column srt named vector whose names match spot names srt. methods Spatial domain methods benchmark. NULL uses every benchmarked producer (BayesSpace, BANKSY, SmoothClust). Method names may written without Run prefix. method_params Named list per-method argument lists. Arguments passed corresponding SCOP producer, never directly backend. n_clusters Optional common number domains. NULL, methods require cluster count use number non-missing gold-standard classes. method-specific q n_clusters method_params wins. metrics Quality metrics selected default plotting. Supported values "ARI", "NMI", "purity". three retained result summary. keep_objects Whether keep successful method's full producer result. default keeps aligned labels compact run metadata. install_missing Whether missing optional backends may enter producer's normal check_r() installation path. default records unavailable without changing R library. seed Seed set inside isolated method process forwarded producers public seed argument unless overridden method_params. timeout Maximum wall time seconds isolated run, including process start result serialization. Inf disables timeout. poll_interval Seconds process-tree memory samples. verbose Whether print message. Default TRUE.

text: srt_query object class Seurat annotated cell types. srt_ref Seurat object count matrix representing reference object. provided, similarities calculated cells query reference objects. provided, similarities calculated within query object. query_assay assay use query object. provided, default assay query object used. ref_assay assay use reference object. provided, default assay reference object used. ref_pca PCA reduction reference object use calculating distance metric. ref_harmony Harmony reduction reference object use calculating distance metric. ref_umap Name UMAP reduction reference object. provided, first UMAP reduction found reference object used. ref_group grouping variable reference object. variable used group cells heatmap columns. provided, cells treated one group. projection_method Projection method use. Options "model" "knn". "model" selected, function try use pre-trained UMAP model reference object projection. "knn" selected, function directly find nearest neighbors using distance metric. nn_method Nearest neighbor search method use. Options "raw", "annoy", "rann". "raw" selected, function use brute-force method find nearest neighbors. "annoy" selected, function use Annoy library approximate nearest neighbor search. "rann" selected, function use RANN library approximate nearest neighbor search. provided, function choose search method based size query reference datasets. finite dense inputs using cosine Euclidean distance, raw path uses bounded-memory compiled top-k kernel unless full distance matrix requested. metrics sparse inputs retain existing proxyC path. k number nearest neighbors find cell query object. distance_metric distance metric use calculating pairwise distances cells. Options include: "pearson", "spearman", "cosine", "correlation", "jaccard", "ejaccard", "dice", "edice", "hamman", "simple matching", "faith". Additional distance metrics can also used, "euclidean", "manhattan", "hamming", etc. vote_fun Function used aggregating nearest neighbors reference object. Options "mean", "median", "sum", "min", "max", "sd", "var", etc. provided, default "mean". verbose Whether print message. Default TRUE.

code: if (interactive()) {   data(pancreas_sub)   thisutils::check_r("satijalab/seurat-data")    InstallData <- thisutils::get_namespace_fun("SeuratData", "InstallData")   InstallData("panc8")   data(panc8)   panc8 <- UpdateSeuratObject(panc8)   set.seed(98)   cells_sub <- unlist(     lapply(       split(colnames(panc8), panc8$dataset),       function(x) sample(x, size = 200)     )   )   panc8_sub <- subset(panc8, cells = cells_sub)   counts <- GetAssayData5(     panc8_sub,     layer = "counts"   )   panc8_sub <- CreateSeuratObject(     counts = counts,     meta.data = panc8_sub@meta.data   )   panc8_sub <- panc8_sub[Matrix::rowSums(counts) > 0, ]   panc8_sub <- panc8_sub[toupper(     rownames(panc8_sub)   ) %in% toupper(     rownames(pancreas_sub)   ), ]   panc8_sub$celltype <- gsub("_", "-", panc8_sub$celltype)   panc8_sub$celltype <- gsub(" ", "-", panc8_sub$celltype)   use_data <- thisutils::get_namespace_fun("usethis", "use_data")   use_data(     panc8_sub,     compress = "xz",     overwrite = TRUE   ) }

code: if (interactive()) {   PrepareEnv()   check_python("scvelo")   scv <- import("scvelo")   adata <- scv$datasets$pancreas()   pancreas <- adata_to_srt(adata)   set.seed(98)   cells <- sample(colnames(pancreas), size = 1000)   pancreas_sub <- pancreas[, cells]   pancreas_sub <- pancreas_sub[Matrix::rowSums(     GetAssayData5(       pancreas_sub,       layer = "counts"     )   ) > 0, ]   pancreas_sub[["CellType"]] <- pancreas_sub[["clusters_coarse"]]   pancreas_sub[["SubCellType"]] <- pancreas_sub[["clusters"]]   pancreas_sub[["clusters_coarse"]] <- pancreas_sub[["clusters"]] <- NULL   pancreas_sub[["Phase"]] <- ifelse(     pancreas_sub$S_score > pancreas_sub$G2M_score,     "S",     "G2M"   )   pancreas_sub[["Phase"]][apply(     pancreas_sub[[]][, c("S_score", "G2M_score")],     1,     max   ) < 0, ] <- "G1"   pancreas_sub[["Phase", drop = TRUE]] <- factor(     pancreas_sub[["Phase", drop = TRUE]],     levels = c("G1", "S", "G2M")   )   pancreas_sub$CellType <- gsub("_", "-", pancreas_sub$CellType)   pancreas_sub$CellType <- gsub(" ", "-", pancreas_sub$CellType)   pancreas_sub$SubCellType <- gsub("_", "-", pancreas_sub$SubCellType)   pancreas_sub$SubCellType <- gsub(" ", "-", pancreas_sub$SubCellType)   pancreas_sub@reductions$X_pca <- NULL   pancreas_sub@reductions$X_umap <- NULL   use_data <- thisutils::get_namespace_fun("usethis", "use_data")   use_data(     pancreas_sub,     compress = "xz",     overwrite = TRUE   ) }

code: if (interactive()) {   thisutils::check_r("satijalab/seurat-data")   InstallData <- thisutils::get_namespace_fun("SeuratData", "InstallData")   InstallData("pbmcMultiome")   data(pbmcMultiome)   pbmcMultiome <- UpdateSeuratObject(pbmcMultiome)    set.seed(98)   n_per_type <- ceiling(500 / length(unique(pbmcMultiome$cell_type)))   cells_sub <- unlist(     lapply(       split(colnames(pbmcMultiome), pbmcMultiome$cell_type),       function(x) sample(x, size = min(n_per_type, length(x)))     ),     use.names = FALSE   )   pbmcmultiome_sub <- subset(pbmcMultiome, cells = cells_sub)    peak_counts <- GetAssayData5(pbmcmultiome_sub, assay = "peaks", layer = "counts")   peaks_keep <- names(sort(Matrix::rowSums(peak_counts), decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(12000)]   rna_counts <- GetAssayData5(pbmcmultiome_sub, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")   genes_keep <- names(Matrix::rowSums(rna_counts))[Matrix::rowSums(rna_counts) >= 10]   pbmcmultiome_sub <- subset(pbmcmultiome_sub, features = c(genes_keep, peaks_keep))    use_data <- thisutils::get_namespace_fun("usethis", "use_data")   use_data(     pbmcmultiome_sub,     compress = "xz",     overwrite = TRUE   ) }

code: if (interactive()) {   download.file(     "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/samples/GSM8058nnn/GSM8058244/suppl/GSM8058244_PanIN-LG2.tar.gz",     destfile = "GSM8058244_PanIN-LG2.tar.gz",     mode = "wb"   )   untar("GSM8058244_PanIN-LG2.tar.gz", exdir = ".")   download.file(     "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE254nnn/GSE254829/suppl/GSE254829_codatable_may202024.csv.gz",     destfile = "GSE254829_codatable_may202024.csv.gz",     mode = "wb"   )    spatial <- Seurat::Load10X_Spatial(     data.dir = "GSM8058244_PanIN-LG2",     filename = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"   )   tissue_pos <- utils::read.csv(     file.path("GSM8058244_PanIN-LG2", "spatial", "tissue_positions_list.csv"),     header = FALSE,     row.names = 1   )   spatial <- subset(     spatial,     cells = intersect(colnames(spatial), rownames(tissue_pos)[tissue_pos$V2 == 1])   )   coords <- SeuratObject::GetTissueCoordinates(spatial)   spatial$x <- coords[colnames(spatial), "x"]   spatial$y <- coords[colnames(spatial), "y"]   spatial$sample_id <- "GSM8058244"   spatial$geo_accession <- "GSE254829"   spatial$patient_sample <- "PanIN-LG2"    coda <- utils::read.csv("GSE254829_codatable_may202024.csv.gz", check.names = FALSE)   coda$barcode <- sub("_[0-9]+$", "", coda[[1]])   coda <- coda[coda$sample == "PanIN-LG2" & coda$barcode %in% colnames(spatial), ]   rownames(coda) <- coda$barcode   coda <- coda[colnames(spatial), ]   comp_cols <- c(     "islets", "normal epithelium", "smooth muscle", "fat", "acini", "collagen",     "panin"   )   coda$coda_label <- names(coda[comp_cols])[     max.col(as.matrix(coda[comp_cols]), ties.method = "first")   ]   coda$coda_score <- do.call(pmax, coda[comp_cols])   spatial$coda_label <- coda$coda_label   spatial$coda_score <- coda$coda_score   spatial$panin_grade <- coda$paningrade   for (cc in comp_cols) {     spatial[[paste0("coda_", gsub(" ", ".", cc))]] <- coda[[cc]]   }   spatial@tools$GSE254829_coda_table <- coda[     ,     c(comp_cols, "nontissue", "paningrade", "coda_label", "coda_score")   ]    data(panc8_sub)   shared <- intersect(rownames(spatial), rownames(panc8_sub))   gene_counts <- GetAssayData5(spatial, assay = "Spatial", layer = "counts")   genes_keep <- names(     sort(Matrix::rowSums(gene_counts[shared, , drop = FALSE]), decreasing = TRUE)   )[seq_len(5000)]   spatial <- spatial[genes_keep, ]   spatial$feature_selection <- "top_5000_shared_with_panc8_by_spatial_counts"    use_data <- thisutils::get_namespace_fun("usethis", "use_data")   use_data(     spatial,     compress = "xz",     overwrite = TRUE   ) }

title: scop 0.9.1
text: Internal preprocessing integration workflows now use scop’s Seurat-compatible entry points, enabling validated native acceleration normalization, variable-feature selection, scaling, PCA, neighbor search retaining transparent Seurat fallback unsupported paths. native SCTransform(vst.flavor = "v2") path now supports validated numeric factor vars..regress designs latent.data; unsupported regression designs continue delegate Seurat. native PCA auto path accepts smaller stable trailing eigengaps numerical neighborhood-parity validation, allowing datasets use accelerated implementation. Added CellScoringPlot() paired group/score UMAPs, score distributions, threshold proportions, complete multi-program layouts CellScoring() results. CellRank + Palantir fate workflow now supports MAGIC layers, explicit Schur sizes terminal-state validation, normalized fate/driver/transition payloads, CellRank GAM trend modules, module enrichment, result-CellRankPlot() views. Added RunCOMMOT() COMMOTPlot() official COMMOT spatial communication isolated Python subprocess raw-coordinate provenance optional external H5AD storage. Added RunSpaTalk() SpaTalkPlot() official SpaTalk single-cell spot-reference spatial communication workflows compact unified CCC storage. Added CCCNetworkPlot(plot_type = "spatial"), stored-result slice overlay SpatialCellChat, SpaTalk, COMMOT abundance-scaled group nodes, sender-coloured directed edges, proportion-aware composition pies. RunCNV() backend coverage: copykat, fastCNV, SCEVAN, infercnv, numbat now verified original pipelines real bundled datasets (breast-cancer scRNA-seq, infercnv example, numbat ATC2 example), exact prediction agreement copykat/SCEVAN/numbat Spearman rho = 1.0 fastCNV/infercnv. MERINGUE C++ permutation kernel now traverses weight matrix sparsely (row-major edge list, bit-identical accumulation): nperm = 200 Moran p-values 300 spots drop ~442s ~14s (~30x). RunMERINGUE() gains backend = c("cpp", "r") option; C++ kernels replicate MERINGUE::moranTest()/moranPermutationTest() machine precision (including sample.kind RNG stream). backend = "r" retains original calls honors moran_params. Real-data consistency tests verify wrappers original pipelines (CellChat, SpatialCellChat, LIANA, BayesSpace, MERINGUE, SPOTlight, SpaNorm, SpatialDWLS, RCTD, BANKSY, CARD, SpotSweeper, PRECAST). DorotheaPlot() now follows shared scop plot style: horizontal "bar"/"lollipop" comparison plots, "volcano", "heatmap" via GroupHeatmap(), "dim" (activity vs expression embeddings), "stat" (FeatureStatPlot distributions), "targets" (regulon-target volcano). RunDorothea() examples show FeatureDimPlot() / FeatureStatPlot() TF-activity assay. RunIntegrationBenchmark() compares integration methods scIB-style iLISI/cLISI, ASW, graph connectivity, ARI/NMI scores returns Seurat object. Tables live srt@tools$IntegrationBenchmark printed thisplot::print_colored_table(). IntegrationBenchmarkPlot() draws box (per-cell LISI), heatmap, scatter, UMAP views. LISIPlot() removed; use IntegrationBenchmarkPlot(plot_type = "box"). SCENICPlot() / SCENICPlusPlot(): heatmap_dotplot, eregulon_dim, coverage, network, network_graph, egrn, overlap. "network" draws one hub per TF. Network plots title. Networks use "Chinese" palette = "RdYlBu". Multi-TF legends show top RSS cell type. presto now runtime-optional GitHub backend instead suggested check dependency. Marker fast paths use existing installation without installing , RunCellChat(.fast = TRUE) can resolve backend immunogenomics/presto execution. RunCellRank() now disables PETSc explicitly retrying fate probabilities SciPy’s direct solver, preventing CellRank 2.0.7 silently reverting retry GMRES rejecting harmless floating-point negative probabilities (#380). RunCellRank() defaults dependency-free brandts Schur method , standard scop_env longer fails optional petsc4py slepc4py packages absent. Users can still request schur_method = "krylov" packages installed (#380). CellRank stored-result plotting now follows SCOP’s theme_scop, Chinese, Spectral visual contracts; draws transition projections directly saved sparse transition matrix; supports random walks without requiring trend results; facets trend modules; adds module-enrichment dot plots. CellRank enrichment selects database gene-ID column overlaps actual driver background, including three-column GO tables Entrez symbol identifiers. Linux shared-library preloading keeps package-local load_shared_library() seam, dependency-order retries can tested without attempting mock base dyn.load() function SCOP namespace binding. Coordinate-contract validation now covers unified CCC plots SpatialCellChat, COMMOT, SpaTalk without rejecting coordinate-independent SpatialDWLS proportions. Explicit coordinate_space = "legacy_display" analysis preserves historical lowres--hires fallback; current display plotting remains strict selected scale. Spatial coordinate contract v2 now reads full-resolution VisiumV1/VisiumV2 coordinates, restores imagerow/imagecol order Seurat’s standard VisiumV2 loader stores positionally centroid x/y, preserves explicit generic FOV x/y, normalizes explicitly named legacy image row/column coordinates, applies exactly one selected lowres hires display transform. SpatialCoordinates(), -overlay point/pie/network plots, public wrappers gain appended image.scale argument; variadic wrappers keep named-.... Raw SpatialCellChat analysis longer requires available display scale, coordinate-independent producers longer claim coordinate-contract version. Users longer need modify Seurat @scale.factors slots. Coordinate-dependent stored results created older unknown contract must rerun. RunSlingshot() / CellDimPlot(lineages=) longer fail scale$guide == "none" ggplot2 >= 3.5 ggnewscale older 0.5.0. Colour/fill scales now keep character guide, legend overrides go guides(), ggnewscale pinned >= 0.5.2, failed lineage plot longer discards Slingshot result. RunGSEA() / RunEnrichment() longer fail “replacement 0 rows, data N” cached database carries empty version. KEGG REST API dropped Release line /info/<org>, PrepareDB() now resolves KEGG version release-notes page info endpoint report (retrieval-date fallback; HPO hardened way), enrichment writers tolerate missing versions. RunSpaTalk() now reuses stored RunRCTD() weights SpaTalk method 2, records deconvolution source, accepts working installed SpaTalk package even DESCRIPTION lacks GitHub remote metadata. RunLIANA() now preserves field set returned LIANA’s official consensus mode: rank consensus longer gains -NA aggregate/significance placeholders, aggregate consensus longer gains -NA magnitude/specificity placeholders, deterministic ligand-receptor display identifiers completed SCOP/LIANA export. RunCNV() attaches backend packages search path execution lazy data objects (copykat full.anno, fastCNV geneMetadata, numbat gtf_hg38) resolvable backend namespace code; copykat installed GitHub source (navinlabcode/copykat) removed CRAN. RunCNV(numbat) prefers plain seg column seg_label reading joint_post output, segment identifiers polluted (loh) suffix. RunCNV() numbat extraction vectorized (direct index assignment duplicate averaging instead row--row aggregate/strsplit, plus split()-partitioned bin statistics): 300-seg x 2000-cell joint_post extraction drops ~16s ~1.3s (~12x) bit-identical results. visium_mouse_brain_slices_sub rebuilt current SeuratObject bundled VisiumV2 images can subset . RunRCTD() extracts per-spot all_weights spacexr >= 2.2 doublet_mode = "multi" results. RunSpotSweeper() detects upstream SpotSweeper::localVariance breakage SpatialExperiment colData degrades gracefully. RunSpatialIntegration(PRECAST) writes raw coordinates expected CreatePRECASTObject. RunLIANA() recognizes logfc_comb (liana method score columns) interaction score. Exported theme_scop / theme_spatial listed pkgdown reference index; theme_scop alias test compares function equality rather identity installed-package checks pass. DorotheaPlot(plot_type = "volcano") plots every tested TF, caps Wilcoxon underflow y-axis, colors points direction, labels significant TFs. "targets" labels significant genes leader lines longer pile x = 0. Removed wrappers whose upstream dependencies unavailable uncompilable: RunSpatialQM(), RunSemla*() wrappers, BASS/SpatialMNN branches RunSpatialIntegration() (PRECAST unaffected), SPATA2 backend = "r" path RunSpatialGradientFeatures() (C++ backend ; srt_to_spata2()/spata2_to_srt() removed well). Removed legacy spatial registry result-discovery APIs (GetSpatialResult(), ListSpatialMethods(), SpatialBackendStatus(), SpatialResultInfo()). Use producer’s documented srt@tools entry , provided, dedicated result accessor plotting function. CaSpER branch RunCNV() removed: runCaSpER() segfaults deterministically R >= 4.5 (HMM manualSegment, even 50 cells), upstream unmaintained since 2019, Bioconductor dependency set archived. RunCNV() now supports copykat, fastCNV, scevan, infercnv, numbat. RunBenchmark() / BenchmarkPlot() replaced RunSpatialBenchmark() / SpatialBenchmarkPlot(). old names removed. RunCell2fate() examples call RunStandardWorkflow() plot time, uncertainty, module activation, module state. env_requirements() also shows standalone Cell2fate Python 3.9 stack. ListLIANAResources() replaced ListCCCDB(), enumerates ligand-receptor databases prior models across CCC backends unified db/species/status schema. New PrepareCCCDB() prepares CellTalk CellChat databases (TERM2GENE/TERM2NAME, R.cache-backed); CellTalk/CellChat branches removed PrepareDB(). Database listing outputs unified (ListDB() ListCCCDB() return plain data frames; colored console rendering available via thisplot::print_colored_table()). Python-converted object interop: PAGAPlot(), VelocityPlot()/CellDimPlot(velocity=), RunPAGA(use_rna_velocity), RunCellRank(), DE consumers (VolcanoPlot(), DEtestPlot(), RunEnrichment(), RunGSEA(), …), RunScissor() now fall back scanpy/scVelo result slots (paga, rank_genes_groups, velocity_umap, dpt_pseudotime, connectivities) stored adata_to_srt().

title: scop 0.9.0
text: New optional-backend wrappers: RunCHOIR() significance-based hierarchical clustering RunCell2fate() RNA-velocity modeling, pinned backend provenance, strict result validation, metadata writeback, resumable artifacts. Added RunCell2location() official Python cell2location reference-signature learning spatial abundance mapping, manifest-validated resume, signature reuse, Cell2locationPlot() visualizations. Added RunCNV() unified CNV workflow optional copykat, infercnv, SCEVAN, fastCNV backends, standardized srt@tools[["CNV"]] storage, CNVPlot() visualizations; added RunESTIMATE() stromal/immune/tumor-purity scoring EstimateScorePlot() / EstimateGenePlot(). GRN analysis extended: RunSCENICPlus() SCENIC+ multi-omics workflows, plus standalone RunGRNBoost2(), RunGENIE3(), RunCisTarget() modules sharing SCENIC regulon infrastructure. Added RunSpatialCellChat() SpatialCellChat v3 producer cell-, spot-, composition-level communication, raw--micron coordinate contracts schema-v1 provenance; GetCCCObject() SpatialCellChatPlot() provide stored-result access. Spatial analysis framework: added spatial contract schema v1 (SpatialCoordinates(), GetSpatialResult(), GetSpatialGraph()), shared spatial method registry (ListSpatialMethods(), SpatialBackendStatus(), SpatialResultInfo()), strict raw-coordinate defaults, sparse BiocNeighbors-backed graph kernels SmoothClust, spatial-variable-feature, spatial-neighborhood paths. Added RunSpatialBenchmark() SpatialBenchmarkPlot() failure-tolerant comparison stable spatial-domain clustering methods (ARI/NMI/purity, runtime, peak memory); added ClusterTreePlot() multi-resolution clustering trees.
